name: [BETA] KF1 Karting
desc:
🏁 KF1 KARTING [BETA] 🏁

Experience the thrill of competitive kart racing in a fast-paced, realistic environment. Race against players worldwide, master different tracks, and push your limits on the circuit.

🚗 FEATURES
• Over 5 real-life kart chassis with authentic liveries
• Multiple kart classes — from Rentals to SUPERKARTS and DRIFT KARTS!
• 10+ unique tracks inspired by real circuits
• Online multiplayer racing — challenge players anytime
• Official Karting League — join teams and compete
• Realistic grip system (wet tracks & cold tyres)
• Kart tuning & tyre change system

🏎️ GAMEPLAY
KF1 Karting delivers an immersive racing experience where skill and consistency matter. Adapt to track conditions, fine-tune your kart, and outpace your rivals.

⚠️ NOTICE
• Game is in BETA — expect bugs and glitches
• Requires moderate/high PC performance (lower graphics if needed)

*Not affiliated with the real KF1 Karting company*
